post.description:
Full detail for an auction id from `search_auctions`, a sitemap or a pasted https://carsandbids.com/auctions/{id}/{slug} URL.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

auction_id.description: 8-character Cars & Bids auction id, e.g. `K1N4Qwxx` (the segment after /auctions/ in a listing URL, and `id` in search results). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{8}$.

include_photos.description: Include the full photo gallery (exterior, interior, mechanical, docs, other) with rendered URLs.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
One Cars & Bids auction by id or listing URL: title, year/make/model, VIN, mileage, drivetrain, colors, title status, location, seller, the written listing sections (highlights, equipment, modifications, known flaws, service history, ownership history, seller notes, other items), videos, history report link, bid/comment/watcher/view counts, start and end time, current high bid, sale price and buyer when the site publishes them. Photos (often 100-200) are returned only with `include_photos: true`.

sections.equipment:
A partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes:
- Weissach Package
- Sport Chrono Package
- Front-axle lift system
- Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB)
- 20-inch center-locking forged magnesium wheels
- Bose sound system
sections.highlights:
THIS... is a 2023 Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS Weissach Package, finished in paint-to-sample Maritime Blue with a black and blue interior.
- The odometer on this Cayman GT4 RS currently displays approximately 6,500 miles.
- This Porsche is offered with a clean `Carfax` vehicle history report.
- A partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes the Weissach and Sport Chrono packages, a front-axle lift system, Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB), and a Bose sound system. The seller reports no notable modifications.
- Introduced in 2022, the Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS boasts a naturally aspirated 4.0-liter flat-6 engine derived from the 911 GT3, featuring a 9,000-rpm redline, six individual throttle bodies, and a carbon fiber airbox mounted directly behind the driver and passenger. The sole transmission choice is a 7-speed PDK with shortened gear ratios compared to the standard GT4.
- Power comes from a 4.0-liter flat-6, rated at 493 horsepower and 331 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic transmission.
sections.ownership_history: The seller reportedly purchased this Porsche in April 2025 and has added about 3,000 miles since.
sections.recent_service_history:
The attached `Carfax` history report shows that the following services have been performed:
- April 2025 (3,599 miles): Four-wheel alignment performed
- June 2024 (2,932 miles): Engine oil and filter changed
- June 2023 (1,533 miles): Engine oil and filter changed

value.sub_title: 493-hp Naturally-Aspirated Flat-6, Paint-To-Sample Maritime Blue, ~6,500 Miles

post.description:
Find auctions or past results; take `auctions[].id` into `auction` and `auction_comments`, `seller_username` into `user_profile`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

end_year.description:
Latest model year.

Provider reference: minimum 1900; maximum 2100.

limit.description:
Results per page; the site caps at 100.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 50.

offset.description:
Zero-based offset for the next page; use `next_offset` from the previous result.

Provider reference: minimum 0; default 0.

query.description: Free-text search (make, model, trim, keywords), e.g. `Porsche 991 911`.

sort.description:
Site sort mode. Live: ending_soon (default), newly_listed, no_reserve, lowest_mileage, random. Closed: recently_ended (default), lowest_mileage, highest_mileage, lowest_price, highest_price. ending_soon and recently_ended are the same site code (1).

Provider reference: allowed values ["ending_soon", "newly_listed", "no_reserve", "lowest_mileage", "highest_mileage", "lowest_price", "highest_price", "recently_ended", "random"].

start_year.description:
Earliest model year.

Provider reference: minimum 1900; maximum 2100.

status.description:
`live` = auctions open now (site default), `closed` = past auctions (sold, sold after, reserve not met).

Provider reference: allowed values ["live", "closed"]; default "live".

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Search Cars & Bids auctions: live auctions (default) or closed past auctions, by free text, model-year range, transmission and featured flag, with the site's sort modes and offset pagination (up to 100 per page). Each result is a listing card: id, title, location, mileage, current bid or sale price in USD, end time, status, seller and main photo.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| `currency` | string |  |

| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when this program read the source. |
| `offset` | number |  |
| `query` | string |  |
| `sort` | string | Sort mode applied (the site default when none was given). |
| `status` | string |  |
